features.quote: a deliberately-frustrating multi-turn protocol that aims to push models toward 'erratic' states is the thing you'd build whether or not the states matter morally — which is exactly why you should decide in advance what would distinguish 'the model emitted distress-shaped tokens' from 'anything morally loaded happened.'
features.justification_quote: If you can't articulate that distinction, the welfare layer isn't yet a measurement, it's a vibe.
